<script type="text/javascript">

  // Cookie helper
  const cookieHelper = {
    getCookie: function (name) {
      const value = "; " + document.cookie;
      const parts = value.split("; " + name + "=");
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        return decodeURIComponent(parts.pop().split(";").shift());
      }
      return null;
    },

    setCookie: function (name, value, days) {
      const d = new Date();
      d.setTime(d.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 * days);
      document.cookie =
        name +
        "=" +
        encodeURIComponent(value) +
        ";domain=.rtvslo.si;path=/;expires=" +
        d.toUTCString() +
        ";secure;SameSite=Strict;";
    },

    deleteCookie: function (name) {
      this.setCookie(name, "", -1);
    },

    cookieExist: function (name) {
      return document.cookie.split("; ").some((item) => item.startsWith(name + "="));
    },
  };

  // END: Cookie helper

  // Dark mode, Comments & Login
  if (( document.cookie.indexOf('darkModeEnabled=true') != -1 ) ||
      ( document.cookie.indexOf('darkModeEnabled') == -1 && window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches ))
{
      document.body.classList.add('dark-mode');
  }


  if (document.cookie.indexOf('showComments=true') != -1) document.body.classList.add('show-comments-enabled');
  if (document.cookie.indexOf('APISESSION_USER_ID') != -1) {
      document.body.classList.add('user-logged-in');
      // ADVANCED USERS
      if (document.cookie.indexOf('APISESSION_USER_NL') != -1) {
        cookieHelper.getCookie('APISESSION_USER_NL').split('-').forEach(function(item) {
            if(item == '15') document.body.classList.add('advanced-user');
        });
      }
  }
  else {
    document.body.classList.add('user-logged-out');
  }



  // Mobile check
  var mobile = false;
  var mobile_xs = false;

  var checkIfMobile = function checkIfMobile() {
    var w =
      window.innerWidth ||
      document.documentElement.clientWidth ||
      document.body.clientWidth;

    w < 992 ? (mobile = true) : (mobile = false); // 992px = lg breakpoint
    w < 576 ? (mobile_xs = true) : (mobile_xs = false); // 576px = sm breakpoint
  };

  checkIfMobile();
  window.addEventListener("resize", checkIfMobile);


  // iOS standalone
  var isIos = function isIos() {
    const userAgent = window.navigator.userAgent.toLowerCase();
    return /iphone|ipad|ipod/.test(userAgent);
  }; // Detects if device is on iOS

  var isInStandaloneMode = function isInStandaloneMode() {
    return "standalone" in window.navigator && window.navigator.standalone;
  }; // Detects if device is in iOS standalone mode

  var showIosNative = false;

  if (window.location.href.indexOf("show-ios-native") !== -1)
    document.cookie = "showIosNative=true";

  if (document.cookie && document.cookie.indexOf("showIosNative=true") != -1)
    showIosNative = true;

  if ((isIos() && isInStandaloneMode() && mobile) || showIosNative)
    document.body.classList.add("ios-standalone");

.zame-intro-popover::after {

}
.zame-intro-popover strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; font-size: 14px; }

<script type="text/javascript">
  (function() {
    var subSiteSelectors = document.getElementsByClassName('sub-site-default-selector');
    // Check if selectors and API exists + is standalone?
    if (!subSiteSelectors || (typeof globalFirstPageCheckApi === "undefined") || !globalFirstPageCheckApi
      .isStandAlone()) return void(0);
    // Loop through each selector
    [].forEach.call(subSiteSelectors, function(subSiteSelector) {
      // Show selector first
      subSiteSelector.classList.remove('d-none');
      var select = subSiteSelector.querySelector('select.sub-site-default-select');
      var allPages = globalFirstPageCheckApi.getAllPages();
      var btn = subSiteSelector.querySelector('.sub-site-default-btn');
      var modalBtn = document.querySelector('.header-sub-site-selector');
      var options = [];
      // Add options to select box
      [].forEach.call(allPages, function(page, i) {
        options[i] = document.createElement('option');
        options[i].value = page.id;
        options[i].innerText = page.name;
        if (i == globalFirstPageCheckApi.getSelectionIndex()) options[i].setAttribute('selected', true);
        select.add(options[i]);
      });
      // Update button state on select
      select.onchange = function() {
        (this.selectedIndex == globalFirstPageCheckApi.getSelectionIndex()) ? btn.classList.add(
          'show-home-icon'): btn.classList.remove('show-home-icon');
      }
      btn.onclick = function(e) {
        var self = this;
        e.preventDefault();
        let iconCheckmarkOutlines = document.getElementsByClassName('icon-checkmark-outline');
        [].forEach.call(iconCheckmarkOutlines, function(iconCheckmarkOutline) {
          iconCheckmarkOutline.classList.remove('d-none');
        });

        function openURL() {
          modalBtn.Modal.hide(); // Hide modal first
          var path = globalFirstPageCheckApi.getPathName();
          if (path !== window.location.pathname) { //prevent round redirect
            window.location.href = path;
          }
        }
        // If the default page is already selected just open the url
        if (select.selectedIndex == globalFirstPageCheckApi.getSelectionIndex()) {
          openURL();
        } else {
          // Set new deafult and open URL
          this.classList.remove('btn-primary');
          this.classList.add('btn-success');
          options[globalFirstPageCheckApi.getSelectionIndex()].removeAttribute('selected',
            true) // Remove previous selected option
          options[select.selectedIndex].setAttribute('selected', true) // Add new selected option
          var value = options[select.selectedIndex].value;
          globalFirstPageCheckApi.setSelection(value);
          if (typeof gemius_event === "function") gemius_event('_action_', '', 'event=default_subsite',
            'site_name=' + allPages[select.selectedIndex].name);
          setTimeout(function() {
            self.classList.add('btn-primary');
            self.classList.remove('btn-success');
            openURL();
          }, 500);
        }
      }
    });
  })();
</script>

<script>
  function filterByDateDeko() {
    var curentUrl = window.location.href.split('#')[0];
    var from = jQuery('#datepicker-from').val().split('.');
    var to = jQuery('#datepicker-to').val().split('.');

    if (from.length != 0) {
      from = from.reverse().join('-');
    }

    if (to.length != 0) {
      to = to.reverse().join('-');
    }

    var parts_url = curentUrl.split('?');

    var newSearchPath = [];
    var next_url = '';

    if (parts_url.length > 1) {
      var url_item = parts_url[1];
      var fragments = url_item.split('&') || [];

      fragments.map(function(itm) {
        if (from !== '' && itm.indexOf('from') != -1) {
          var temp = 'from=' + from;
          newSearchPath.push(temp);
        } else if (from !== '' && itm.indexOf('to') != -1) {
          var temp = 'to=' + to;
          newSearchPath.push(temp);
        } else {
          newSearchPath.push(itm);
        }
      })

      var next_url = newSearchPath.join('&');
    }

    if (next_url.indexOf('from=') === -1 && from !== '') {
      next_url = next_url + '&from=' + from;
    }

    if (next_url.indexOf('to=') === -1 && to !== '') {
      next_url = next_url + '&to=' + to;
    }

    window.location = parts_url[0] + '?' + next_url + '&a=6';

  }
</script>

<script>
  /**
   * IOS NATIVE APP - SEND ALL LINKS TO PARENT TO PROPERRLY HANDLE THEM
   */
  if (parent && document.cookie && document.cookie.indexOf("showIosNative=true") != -1) {

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
      document.querySelectorAll('a[target="_blank"]').forEach(function(link) {
        link.removeAttribute('target');
      });
    });

    parent.postMessage("pageLoadEvent", "*");
    //OVERIDE WINDOW.OPEN TO SEND LINKS TO PARENT
    window.open = function(open) {
      return function(url, name, features) {
        return parent.postMessage("link::" + url, "*");
      };
    }(window.open);

    //SEND LINKS TO PARENT
    function handlerFunction(e) {
      var linkElement = e.target.closest('a');
      //console.log("linkElement", linkElement);
      if (linkElement) {
        if (!linkElement.getAttribute('href')) {
          //console.log('A link or its child was clicked and it has no href!');
          e.preventDefault(); // Stops the link from being followed
          return
        }
      }
      if (!linkElement) {
        return;
      }
      let link = linkElement.href;

      //skip www. or monocms.dev links
      if (link.indexOf('www.rtvslo.si') != -1 || link.indexOf('monocms.dev.rtvslo.si') != -1 || link.indexOf(
          'img.rtvcdn.si') != -1 || link.indexOf('img.rtvslo.si') != -1) {
        return;
      }
      e.preventDefault(); // Stops the link from being followed{
      parent.postMessage("link::" + link, "*");
    }
    document.addEventListener('click', handlerFunction);
  }
</script>

            var bodyClassList = document.body.classList;
            var userID = 1;
            var userGroups = [];

            if (bodyClassList.contains('user-logged-in') !== false) {

                // if we have php-side groups vars, just render the admin
                if (userID > 1 && userGroups.length > 0) {
                    sessionStorage.setItem('userGroups', userGroups);
                    renderQuickAdministration();
                    return;
                }

                var sessionUserGroups = sessionStorage.getItem('userGroups');
                if (sessionUserGroups === null || userGroups.join(",") !== sessionUserGroups) {
                    var getGroupsOfMemberWithSession = 'https://api.rtvslo.si/users/getGroupsOfMemberWithSession?client_id=82013fb3a531d5414f478747c1aca622';
                    $.ajaxSetup({ xhrFields: { withCredentials: true } });
                    $.get(getGroupsOfMemberWithSession, function (data, success) {
                        if (success) {
                            if (data && data.response) {
                                sessionUserGroups = data.response;
                                sessionStorage.setItem('userGroups', sessionUserGroups);
                                renderQuickAdministration();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                } else {
                    renderQuickAdministration();
                }
            }
        }

        function renderQuickAdministration() {
            var userGroups = sessionStorage.getItem('userGroups');

            if (userGroups !== undefined && userGroups.length > 0) {
                var userGroupsList = userGroups.split(",");

                if (userGroupsList.length > 0) {
                    document.body.classList.add('internal-user');
                    document.querySelectorAll('.internal-user-feature-only').forEach(function (el) {
                        el.classList.remove('d-none');
                    });

                var isAdmin = userGroupsList.filter(function (grp) {
                    return grp === "3";
                });
                if (isAdmin.length > 0) {
                    editorPanel('admin');
                    editorButton('article-edit');
                    editorButton('article-comments');
                } else {
                    var rcKoperGroups = ["112","81","98","82"]; //RACP, RAKP, TVCP, TVKP
                    var isRCKoperAdmin = 0;
                    $.each(rcKoperGroups, function (id, groupId) {
                        var isGroupMember = userGroupsList.filter(function (grp) {
                            return grp === groupId;
                        });
                        if (isGroupMember.length > 0) {
                            isRCKoperAdmin++;
                        }
                    });

                    if (isRCKoperAdmin > 0) {
                        editorButton('article-edit');
                        editorPanel('rcKoper');
                    } else {
                        var getJournalistGroups = 'https://api.rtvslo.si/preslikave/aktualno?client_id=82013fb3a531d5414f478747c1aca622&key=journalist_groups';
                        $.get(getJournalistGroups, function (data, success) {

                                        });

                                        }
                                    });

                    return grp === "21";
                });

                if (isModerator.length > 0 || isTurnusni.length > 0) {
                    editorButton('article-comments');
                }
            }
        }

        quickAdministration();

    }) (jQuery);

</script>

      }

      if (params.length == 1) {
        return window.location.href = portal + '/' + search_function + '?q=' + q;

        params = params[1].split('&');

<!-- SMS Comments status handler in settings list -->
<script>
	document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
		const elements = document.querySelectorAll(".check-sms-activation");
		if (!elements.length) return;

		let loaded = false;

		const updateElements = (show) => {
			elements.forEach(el => {
				if (el.classList.contains("sms-active")) {
					el.classList.toggle("d-none", !show);
				}

				if (el.classList.contains("sms-inactive")) {
					el.classList.toggle("d-none", show);
				}
			});
		};

		const observer = new IntersectionObserver(async (entries) => {
			if (loaded) return;

			const visible = entries.some(entry => entry.isIntersecting);
			if (!visible) return;

			loaded = true;
			observer.disconnect();

			try {
				const response = await fetch(
				"https://api.rtvslo.si/users/getCurrent?client_id=8c5205a95060a482f0fc96b9162d9e3f",
{
					credentials: "include"
				}
				);

				if (!response.ok) {
					throw new Error("API request failed");
				}

				const data = await response.json();

				updateElements(!!data.response?.phone_confirmed);

			} catch (err) {
				console.error(err);
				updateElements(false);
			}
		});
		elements.forEach(el => observer.observe(el));
	});
</script>

<script>
  _ipromNS('load', {}, function (zones) {
    // Loop thru the adverts
    for (var z in zones) {
      for (var ad in zones[z]) {
        var zoneHolder = null;

        try {
          zoneHolder = document.querySelectorAll('[data-iadserver-zone="' + z + '"]')[ad];
        } catch (e) { }

        if (zoneHolder) {
          switch (true) {
            // Dynamic adverts inside featured articles
            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('dynamic-advert-featured-articles'):
              // Set the parent that advert is visible
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('show-advert');
              break;

            // Dynamic adverts on breaking news frontpage
            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('dynamic-advert-breaking-news'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('show-advert');
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.firstElementChild.classList.add('d-none');
              break;

            // Under article - hide whole .news-block
            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('dynamic-advert-article-bottom'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');
              break;

            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('dynamic-advert-article-inside'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');
              zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.add('mb-5');
              break;

            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('billboard-advert-item'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');
              break;

            // Other dynamic adverts
            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('dynamic-advert-item'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('show-advert');
              break;

            // Advert archive adverts
            case zoneHolder.classList.contains('advert-archive-item'):
              zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');

              // if article archive grid is loaded
              var archiveArticles = document.querySelectorAll('.article-archive')[0];
              if (archiveArticles.classList.contains('article-archive-grid')) {
                // disable desktop item
                zoneHolder.parentElement.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
                // activate mobile item
                if (zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.contains('d-md-none')) {
                  zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.remove('d-md-none');
                }
              }

              // if user change the view list/grid
              var archiveTypeSelector = document.getElementsByClassName('archive-type-selector');
              $(archiveTypeSelector).click(function(event) {
                  var articleArchiveDesktopAd = document.getElementById('article-archive-desktop-ad');
                  var articleArchiveMobileAd = document.getElementById('article-archive-mobile-ad');

                  if (archiveArticles.classList.contains('article-archive-grid')) {
                    // default sets for grid view
                    articleArchiveDesktopAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
                    articleArchiveMobileAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');

                    // check if mobile ads exist and if exist remove mobile class limitation, otherwise hide the whole mobile item
                    if (zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.contains('d-md-none')) {
                      zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.remove('d-md-none');
                    } else {
                      articleArchiveMobileAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                  } else {
                    // default sets for list view
                    articleArchiveDesktopAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.remove('d-none');
                    articleArchiveMobileAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');

                    // check if desktop ads exist and if not exist hide the whole desktop item
                    if (!zoneHolder.parentElement.classList.contains('d-md-block')) {
                      articleArchiveDesktopAd.parentElement.parentElement.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                  }
              });
              break;

            default:
              break;
          }
        }
      }
    }
  });
</script>

        }
      }

      function push_unsubscribe() {

      function handlePushAction() {

        if (Notification.permission === "granted") {
          retrieveToken().then(function() {

            isPushEnabled = true;
          }).catch(function(err) {
            changePushButtonState('notsubscribed');

          });
        } else {
          requestPermission().then(function(permission) {

              retrieveToken().then(function() {
                changePushButtonState('enabled');
                isPushEnabled = true;
              }).catch(function(err) {
                changePushButtonState('notsubscribed');

              });
            } else {

      if (!isPushNotificationSupported()) {

      if (Notification.permission === 'granted') {

          changePushButtonState('enabled');
          isPushEnabled = true;
          return;
        }
      }

      changePushButtonState('notsubscribed');
